run_gguf_hash_cli: run the gguf_hash CLI to compute SHA1, SHA256, and UUID5 hashes of a GGUF model file
compute_layer_hashes: compute per-tensor SHA1 and SHA256 hashes for each layer in a GGUF file
compute_file_hashes: compute overall SHA1 and SHA256 hashes for an entire GGUF model file
compute_uuid5_hash: compute a UUID5 hash derived from SHA1 of all tensor data in a GGUF file
run_gguf_hash_no_layer: run gguf_hash CLI with --no-layer flag to skip per-tensor hash output
